authorization: 2026-10-27 user requests preparing an E42 retrain with one fixed training/selection Loss, then starting training in background. Stage-two capacity research is not launched.
hypothesis: A reproducible E42 scratch baseline with aligned optimization and selection is needed before changing architecture. Improvement over historical E42 is an empirical question.
initialization: scratch; seeded original E42 default parameter initialization; no checkpoint loaded
data: reference_workset_v5 train16000 in original logical order; frozen train_monitor500 and dev_monitor500; no v6 training members
architecture: byte-identical E42 96x12 rectangle model and features/batches; FFN dropout .05; no graph prenorm or graph-step projection
loss: E64.frozen_E42_G.v1: original eight full-weight E42 terms from first batch; no ramp, no occupancy selector, no late reference relaxation
selection: same fixed G on dev_monitor500; best improves by >1e-5; LR/early-stop significant improvement threshold max(1e-5,0.001*baseline); no Q or image reselection
evaluation: one frozen selected best: full raw dev2000, unchanged flash dev500, fixed same100 unscored reference/current/E42 gallery, saved learning curves
comparisons: historical E42 best51 is preserved. E57 has related scratch fixed-G controls, with subset/order/execution differences; E64 is a baseline protocol rebuild, not first evidence that unified G is trainable
interpretation: user draft feedback primary; fixed G main numerical reference; flash Q auxiliary. Single seed on adaptively exposed development data, no independent generalization claim and no automatic promotion
failure_policy: Nonfinite objective/gradient blocks Adam update and saves latest; no automatic architecture repair, seed sweep or stage-two launch; STOP and cumulative training budget retained
